name: io.github.nirholas/home-mcp
title: three.ws Home
description: Read and safely act on a real Home Assistant house: floors, rooms, live state, the household's own scenes, and gated service calls.

environmentVariables.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Home Assistant instance, e.g. https://abc123.ui.nabu.casa. It has to be a URL this process can actually reach: a server outside the house cannot route to 192.168.x.x, so a LAN-only home needs Home Assistant Cloud or the household's own reverse proxy.

environmentVariables.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A Home Assistant long-lived access token (Home Assistant, your profile, Security, Long-lived access tokens, Create token). It carries the full rights of the account that minted it, so mint it from an account with only the access this agent should have.

environmentVariables.name: HOME_ALLOWED_ENTITIES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated entity ids the person running this server has pre-approved for guarded actions, e.g. lock.office_door. This is the ONLY way an action that opens the house runs over stdio, and it is deliberately a human, out-of-band decision: no tool can add to it. Per entity, never per domain. Leave unset to refuse every such action.
